ideas.pitch: A real-time overlay and audio communication tool designed for 4-player BGMI squads to analyze match zones and coordinate drops.
ideas.title: BattleZone Squad Telemetry HUD
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tailored specifically for the 4-player team requirement and BYOD format of this esports tournament, giving competing teams an edge in coordination.

ideas.pitch: An automated voice assistant that reviews previous match drops and suggests optimal landing spots based on cumulative tournament scoring dynamics.
ideas.title: DropZone AI Strat Coach
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages real-time voice interaction patterns similar to previous hackathon winners, highly applicable to fast-paced mobile battle royales.

ideas.pitch: A rapid-deployment web dashboard for tracking multi-round eliminations and live cumulative scores across multiple maps for tournament organizers.
ideas.title: BGMI Tournament Live Bracket & Leaderboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate logistical pain point for event coordinators managing multi-round tournament scoring.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight web tool that parses match result summaries and maps out elimination heatmaps for post-match analysis.
ideas.title: Esports Match Replay Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers a polished, fully working data visualization demo within a tight 24-48 hour window.

ideas.pitch: A quick ping and communication utility app built for BYOD mobile devices to minimize latency during high-stakes tournament rounds.
ideas.title: SquadSync Mobile Companion
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the BYOD constraint of the event by providing a companion tool running smoothly on personal smartphones.
